rules.retrieved_snippet: Lex Mundi: the Act is the main law on processing personal data in Ghana, enacted to give effect to the privacy guarantee in Article 18(2) of the 1992 Constitution. DLA Piper: data controllers must register with the Data Protection Commission (certificate valid two years).

Search summary of the Act: establishes the Cyber Security Authority, focuses on protecting critical information infrastructure; 100 sections and 3 schedules including Blocking and Taking Down Illegal Content, Administrative Penalties and Unlawful Access; assent 29 December 2020.

Search summary of GhaLII page: object is to facilitate electronic communications and related transactions in the public interest; applies to electronic transactions and records of every type; amended by Act 838 (2012) and Act 1038 (2020).

Search summary of GhaLII page: consolidates the laws relating to prohibition of money laundering and provides for the Financial Intelligence Centre; first section states a person shall not engage in money laundering; Official Gazette 29 December 2020.
